title: defi-dividend-base-contract
tagline: Base solidity contract to get started with creating a dividend based token
description: Base solidity contract to get started with creating a token with dividends being used in their tokenomics. This allows developers to spend less time worrying about the logic to figure out how much dividends to pay and rather focus on the utility of the token they are creating. It allows a specification of the dividend rate.
how_its_made: This project is made using Solidity, ethereum's smart contract development language to be able to create a base solidity contract to get started with creating a token with dividends being used in their tokenomics. It allows the developer to specify the rate at which the dividend will be payed out.
